Rina: Heads-up 1 Heartline (dedicated, eu-west) reported p95 spike after late-night deploy. Filing intake here. Ticket: https://support.redwood.example/t/HEARTLINE-621
Owen: Customer shows p95 ~820ms (their SLA 300ms). QPS ~9. They say model was switched to quantized variant in the deploy.
Ben: Release notes show runtime -> runt-2.17 and model variant `clinical-xl-quant`. No routing changes.
Sofia: Quick triage asks: (1) reproduce in staging with their payload/seq distro, (2) rollback vs config patch decision, (3) customer update cadence.
Rina: Proposing P1 — SLA breached for paid Dedicated. Closure criteria: root cause identified + mitigation OR rollback; p95 < 350ms for 1 hour; customer update within 60m. Agree?
Owen: I'll repro in staging with 10qps and their token histogram (mostly 200-1000, tails 1500). Need a scrubbed sample.
Ben: Early hypothesis: quantized variant + runt-2.17 kernel selection may trigger a fallback slow path on long sequences, or KV-cache semantics changed.
deploy-bot: PROD deploy runt-2.17 completed 2026-03-28T01:12:44Z
Owen: Repro started. Initial logs: p50 unchanged, p95 aligns with nodes with low cache utilization. Posting flame graph in ticket in 30m.
infra-bot: rollback-run-2267890300 queued (manual approval required)
Sofia: Product note: if rollback is low-risk we'll do it. Otherwise try config: raise min-ready, enable per-node prewarm, flip preserve-kv-cache=true for that pool (20-45m).
Rina: Sales wants hourly comms and asked about SLA credits. Product to coordinate with Sales on comms.
Ben: If root cause is kernel selection, hotfix could be 3+ hours. If cache warmup, config fix is quick.
Owen: Patch test shows p95 drop when preserve-kv-cache is enabled on canary nodes. Will validate further.
Sofia: Action items: Owen validate canary patch (eng), infra prepare rollback approval (infra), Rina draft customer update (product), Ben add backlog item for CI gating on quantized variants.
Rina: I'll post the customer ack in 30m. Re-open thread if we need to escalate.
